description: This file defines an immutable Java class ImmutableMappingContext that implements the MappingContext interface. It manages mapping engine configurations, including options and conditions, and provides serialization/deserialization to and from JSON. Additionally, it contains an inner builder class for constructing instances.

classes.name: ImmutableMappingContext
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the MappingContext interface, storing mapping engine details, options, and conditions, with JSON serialization support.

classes.name: ImmutableMappingContext.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing ImmutableMappingContext instances, allowing fluent configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableMappingContext instance from a mapping engine string and options JSON object.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a MappingContext from a JSON object by extracting relevant fields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the MappingContext instance into a JSON object, considering schema version and filtering predicate.

methods.name: getMappingEngine
methods.description: Returns the mapping engine identifier string.

methods.name: getIncomingConditions
methods.description: Returns the map of incoming conditions.

methods.name: getOutgoingConditions
methods.description: Returns the map of outgoing conditions.
